description_en: Attaches an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) to a VPC-type ECS instance by calling the AttachNetworkInterface operation with parameters such as NetworkInterfaceId, InstanceId, and NetworkCardIndex
description_zh: 调用AttachNetworkInterface接口，并可以指定NetworkInterfaceId、InstanceId、NetworkCardIndex等参数，附加一个弹性网卡（ENI）到一台专有网络VPC类型ECS实例上
kebab_example: aliyun ecs attach-network-interface --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-interface-id eni-bp17pdijfczax1huji0000 --instance-id i-bp16qstyvxj9gpqw0000 --trunk-network-instance-id eni-f8zapqwj1v1j4ia30000 --wait-for-network-configuration-ready false --network-card-index 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachNetworkInterface

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 实例所在地域的ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表

parameters.description_en:
The index of the network card specified for the ENI.

>The valid values of NetworkCardIndex depend on the instance family. If the instance type does not support NetworkCard, you cannot specify this parameter. If the instance type supports NetworkCard, see [Instance families](~~25378~~) for valid values.
